install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true && command -v python3 >/dev/null && command -v node >/dev/null && python3 -c 'import re, subprocess, sys; html = open("index.html", encoding="utf-8").read(); scripts = re.findall(r"<script[^>]*>(.*?)</script>", html, re.S); assert scripts, "No <script> block found"; [sys.exit(p.returncode) for s in scripts if (p := subprocess.run(["node", "--check"], input=s, text=True)).returncode != 0]'
